flags.message: The provisioned snapshot file is dated 2026-09-17 but its payload's own creation stamp (sJsonCreationDate) is 07/29/2026, and the last entry is the July 29 distribution for the September 28 conference. Either no docket activity (reply brief, amicus) occurred in August-September or the payload was not refreshed; the cell cannot tell which. Forecast written on the assumption that no reply brief was filed.

The frozen 'elevated' band rests on distribution_count 2, but the second distribution followed a call for response after a waiver (the petition was pulled from the May 21 conference), not a relist after consideration. The band anchor therefore overstates the docket signal for this cell; I anchored below the pooled reached rate and said so in reasoning.md.
